Same Paladin as reference bottom-row second character. Distinct from blue Knight, no blue tabard or red cape. Equipment separate large square-headed silver-gold warhammer.

body:
Create production modular 2D cutout sprite assets for Hollow Vale, Arcane Vanguard cel-shaded illustration: crisp black contours, flat shadow planes, clean high-contrast game art. TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no shadows, text, labels or grid lines. Large square image ideally3072x3072. Exactly SIX DIRECTION PANELS arranged three panels across by two panels down. Each panel contains TWELVE ISOLATED DISCONNECTED BODY PARTS in its own 3-column by4-row grid. Overall image therefore9columns by8rows of pieces,72 pieces total. Do NOT draw assembled characters. Every piece entirely in its own evenly spaced cell with20percent padding. Same character and clothing details across every direction, neutral limbs pointing down, hidden joints fully drawn so pieces can move. Panel order upper-left EAST/right profile; upper-middle SOUTHEAST/front three-quarter down-right; upper-right SOUTHWEST/front three-quarter down-left; lower-left WEST/left profile; lower-middle NORTHWEST/rear three-quarter up-left; lower-right NORTHEAST/rear three-quarter up-right. Back views MUST show back of head and clothing, not mirrored front. Within EACH panel exact piece order: row1 head with neck, chest torso excluding arms and excluding skirt below belt, rear cloak/mantle; row2 front lower robe/pelvis, anatomical left upper arm, anatomical right upper arm; row3 anatomical left forearm and empty hand, anatomical right forearm and empty hand, left leg knee-to-ankle; row4 right leg knee-to-ankle,left boot,right boot. All weapons must be OMITTED; hands empty. No glow baked into body. Use very clear isolated pieces. 
Character: Broad stalwart male holy warrior, closed white-gold winged helmet, thick white plate armor with gold edges, white tabard with gold sun, cream cloak, massive armored shoulders, white plate boots. Same Paladin as reference bottom-row second character. Distinct from blue Knight, no blue tabard or red cape. Equipment separate large square-headed silver-gold warhammer.
equipment: Create a transparent 2D cel-shaded fantasy equipment sprite atlas for Paladin. Style: Arcane Vanguard, bold clean dark contours, hard shadow planes, readable game prop shapes. Equipment: large square-headed silver-gold warhammer. Character style context: Broad stalwart male holy warrior, closed white-gold winged helmet, thick white plate armor with gold edges, white tabard with gold sun, cream cloak, massive armored shoulders, white plate boots. Same Paladin as reference bottom-row second character. Distinct from blue Knight, no blue tabard or red cape. Equipment separate large square-headed silver-gold warhammer.. ONLY equipment, no people, body parts or hands. No text/grid/labels/background/ground shadows. All props fully in cells with15percent padding. Exactly SIX props in3columns2rows: same large square-headed silver-gold warhammer in E,SE,SW,W,NW,NE directional order. Genuine six directional views, show backs/straps where appropriate in NW/NE. Keep all handles vertical with grip lower end and head at top; trumpet may point outward horizontally. Clean standalone silhouettes, no glow baked in, exact grid.
vfx: Create an animation-ready 2D cel-shaded VFX atlas for Hollow Vale Paladin. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Exactly8columns4rows,32 isolated square frame cells, each padded, no text/labels/grid/background/characters/equipment. Each row is an eight-frame non-loop effect from start to peak to disappearance. Row1 hammer arc trail; row2 golden hammer impact ring; row3 healing pulse; row4 golden spawn shimmer. Use ivory/gold with warm cream motes. Crisp hand-drawn flame-free HOLY magic, clean shapes, no photoreal smoke, no characters. Effect source centers remain in same point within cells to avoid jitter. Lastframe nearlygone. Effects only as described, no invented attacks or abilities. Sheet 2:1 landscape. All8frames must be visually distinct.
